data: What is the lowest value of Darwin's text-to-text cumulative surprise show in figure 4.6?

The lowest value of Darwin's text-to-text cumulative surprise shown in Figure 4.6 appears to be around -400 bits. This can be inferred from the position of the solid line (Darwin's reading order) at the bottom of the graph, which reaches its lowest point near this value. The dashed line (publication order) also shows a similar trend but remains above the solid line throughout the graph.
